data.title: New open-source method shows the same AI request emits 8.5 times more CO₂ in Texas than in Sweden - Berget AI
data.description: Swedish AI provider Berget AI releases an open-source method for calculating the carbon emissions of every individual AI request, developed with researchers from SEI, WattTime and Klimatkollen — and customers can now follow their emissions per request in the console.
data.keywords: AI cloud, secure cloud, compliant cloud, sustainable infrastructure, AI applications, Europe cloud service
